violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED RICE DOUBLE NESTED IN STEAM WELL OBSERVED AT 114-116F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REMOVE SECONDARY CONTAINER. RICE REHEATED TO 168F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: GREEN CHILE RANCH OBSERVED AT 50F, SALSA VERDE OBSERVED AT 44F IN 1 DR UC.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS AND CFM DISCUSSED AND ADJUSTED UNIT TEMPERATURE. AFTER 30 MINUTES, GREEN CHILE RANCH WAS OBSERVED AT 42F AND SALSA VERDE OBSERVED AT 41F. CFM WILL HAVE EMPLOYEES VERIFY THERMOSTAT IS AT CORRECT SETTING AFTER STOCKING AND CLEANING UNITS. TACO BAMBA (Inspection Date: 05/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no CFM present at beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during inspection. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: in WIC -raw shell eggs stored on shelf above containers of ready to eat foods (ham, kimchi, churro); tuna stored on shelf above sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved raw foods to bottom shelf.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: salsa dispensers in ice bath next to soda machine: chile arbol at 57F, taqueria at 53F, verde at 54F, morita at 53F; portioned chile arbol at 50F in ice bath near chip shelf. EHS observed only bottom of dispenser was in contact with ice.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS discussed with CFM inadequate amount of ice being use to keep salsas at proper cold holding temperatures. EHS discussed with CFM timing of portioned salsas kept on ice being taken out of refrigeration unit. Additional ice will be added to ice bath to keep dispenser submerged in ice and to keep salsas at 41F or below. CFM will have employees take portioned salsas out of refrigerator before lunch/dinner rush, instead of during morning preparation. TACO BAMBA (Inspection Date: 05/28/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: quinoa/bean/corn mix at #7 observed at 48F, pickled red onion (orange juice) observed at 50F in #7.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded food items.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed various squeeze bottles of oils, sauces and shakers of spices, condiments at cookline and around prep units.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label all secondary containers with food name.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: observed fry station ingredients stored beneath paper towel dispenser of hand sink near fry station.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. CFM will stored fry station ingredients farther away from hand sink/paper towel dispenser. EHS recommended installing larger splash guard.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. FACILITY CAN USE DISHWASHER, HOWEVER, EQUIPMENT MUST BE SUBMERGED IN SANITIZER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AFTERWARDS FOR AT LEAST A MINUTE.
